runner.flows: written automatically by the reviewer agent

liveTest.mode: Demo replay + major flows + health. Never pays, stakes, signs in, connects a wallet or submits.

phases.title: Demo replay
phases.about: Screens shown in the demo video, checked on the live app.

steps.title: Demo screen showing 'Deine Familie.'
steps.why: Verifies that the live web app contains the screen text shown in the demo ('Deine Familie.'). A failure indicates the demo may be fake or showing a private screen.

phases.title: Major flows
phases.about: The app's main features, used without an account.

steps.title: Public access redirects to Login page
steps.why: Confirms the application redirects unauthenticated visitors to the login screen.

steps.title: Sign up link is available
steps.why: Verifies that the registration option is visible on the login page.

reasons: Demo replay: 1 demo screen(s) not found on the live site
